lib/organizations/organizationRequiredSe: This is the SERVER half of the refusal (the 2026-09-19 ruling's organization_required envelope). It runs in a Next route handler, where the three client states do not exist: there is no Redux store, no bootstrap to still be resolving, and no picker to render. Its sentence is the wire `message`/`user_message` the CLIENT then reads through the three-state hooks (lib/organizations/fetchWithOrganization.ts holds, asks and replays). Reading useOrganizationRequired here is impossible, not merely unidiomatic.
features/scopes/components/active-contex: The 'Pick an organization' lines are column hints inside the picker's OWN Organization column: they read the picker engine's checked/focused orgs (engine.isOn('org', …), focusOrgId, u.orgs), never appContext.organization_id, so there is no boot race to lose — the hint is true the instant it renders, and the fix is the column beside it. Checked GATES-TAIL-2, 2026-09-25.
features/agents/components/context-previ: 'Choose an organization and the preview shows…' is the first step of the inspector's own drill-down: selection.org comes from the page address the person drives (controlled; the page owns the selection), never from appContext.organization_id, so it cannot be spelled during boot. It is an instruction for the Organization column above it, not a refusal. Checked GATES-TAIL-2, 2026-09-25.
app/(dev)/demos/composer/ComposerPlaygro: Renders 'Choose the organization this chat belongs to.' only when useCanvasWorkspaceConversation returns state 'needs-organization', which that hook derives from selectShouldPromptForOrganization (the three-state signal that already refuses to nudge while boot resolves or after a failed read). The reading lives in the hook one import away; this dev demo only renders its answer. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/canvas/workspace/CanvasChatColu: Renders 'Choose the organization this chat belongs to.' only for conversation state 'needs-organization', which useCanvasWorkspaceConversation derives from selectShouldPromptForOrganization (never true while boot resolves or after a failed organization read). The button calls ensureOrganizationContext and the held chat continues. The reading lives in the hook, not here. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/agent-apps/components/AppWorksp: Passes its sentence to WorkspaceGate, which reads useOrganizationRequired().organizationState itself: the children keep rendering while 'resolving' or 'ready', and OrganizationContextNotice draws 'unavailable' / 'signed_out' in their own words, so the sentence can only appear in the terminal 'required' state. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/organizations/components/Organi: 'Choose an organization' is the screen-reader title of the picker drawer itself (DrawerHeader sr-only), opened by the person pressing the organization button. It names the control, not a refusal, and it is never derived from appContext.organization_id. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/organizations/gate/Organization: This IS the organization gate: the dialog opens only when ensureOrganizationContext has already held a real action for a missing organization (requestOrganizationSelection). 'Choose the organization for this action' is the question the gate asks, spelled after the wait, never from a nullable id during boot. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/secrets/components/VaultItemDet: 'Choose an organization' is the placeholder of the share-into-organization Select, listing the person's memberships to pick a destination. It names an empty field in a picker the person opened, not a refusal, and reads nothing from appContext.organization_id. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/settings/universal/Configuratio: 'Pick an organization' is the placeholder of the compare-against Select, whose options are the person's OTHER memberships. It names an empty field in a picker, not a refusal, and reads nothing from appContext.organization_id. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
features/surfaces/manifests/settings.man: Manifest descriptions written for agents: 'when no organization is selected' documents what a value holds in that state ([] / real values). They describe a state to a reader, they are never rendered to the person as a refusal, and the landing page that supplies the value reads organizationState (FirstScreenTab). Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
lib/organization/selection-cancelled.ts: WORKSPACE_REFUSAL_PATTERN is a regex the toast layer uses to DROP a caller's duplicate refusal toast right after the gate's backstop spoke. The phrases are pattern text, not a sentence shown to anyone. Checked org-refusal round, 2026-09-28.
